content: Welcome to RJIT Alumni Network. Connecting 6000+ graduates across the globe. Alumni Cell contact is managed by Prof. Abhishek Chakraborty for alumni coordination and outreach.

RJIT Alumni Meet (Anjuman 2025) was held at Rustamji Institute of Technology, BSF Academy, Gwalior on 20 December 2025. Alumni interactions and photo gallery are available on the official RJIT alumni page.
11 Feb 2026: Ms. Shalini Dubey (Automobile 2015-2019), entrepreneur based in Germany, visited RJIT and interacted with students on startup opportunities and international engineering career pathways.
10 Feb 2026: Mr. Saurabh Sikarwar (Automobile 1999-2003), Country Head Sales at Wipro Hydraulics, visited RJIT and guided students on industrial careers in core engineering sectors.
07 Feb 2026: Ms. Sandhya Singh (Automobile 2003-2007), Delivery Manager at Volvo Sweden, conducted an online session with RJIT students on global automotive projects and remote collaboration.
